title: Recover the Archive

beats.narrativeText: Using the restored communications network, the learner unlocks the expedition's protected archive.
Dr. Elara Quinn's final report is inside, waiting to explain why the expedition truly stopped.
The learner reads the final report carefully to understand what it reveals.
Comparing the original evidence with the learner's own current findings begins to confirm the whole story.
The learner must complete the missing sections of the archive using their own discoveries.
The completed archive reveals that the expedition suspended operations because their discoveries required careful verification before publication.
The learner reflects on why the expedition chose to preserve their evidence rather than risk incorrect conclusions.
The expedition mystery is resolved, Dr. Quinn's intentions are fully understood, and the archive is restored.

activities.title: Read Final Report
activities.storyContext: The expedition's protected archive has been unlocked, revealing Dr. Elara Quinn's final report.
activities.instructions: Read Dr. Quinn's final report carefully.
activities.output: Notes on what the final report reveals.

activities.title: Compare Original and Current Evidence
activities.storyContext: The learner's own discoveries can now be compared against the expedition's original evidence.
activities.instructions: Compare the original expedition evidence with what you have discovered throughout the campaign.
activities.output: Notes comparing original and current evidence.

activities.title: Complete Missing Archive Sections
activities.storyContext: The archive is almost complete, but a few sections still rely on the learner's own discoveries.
activities.instructions: Complete the missing sections of the archive using your own discoveries.

activities.title: Summarise Findings
activities.storyContext: The archive brings together everything the learner has uncovered about Outpost Echo.
activities.instructions: Summarise the expedition mystery and what it reveals about Dr. Quinn's intentions.
activities.output: A summary of the expedition mystery.

activities.title: Write a Letter to Future Explorers
activities.storyContext: Dr. Quinn preserved evidence for future Explorers to continue the investigation.
activities.instructions: Write a letter to future Explorers explaining the importance of careful investigation.

activities.title: Discoveries That Took Years to Verify
activities.storyContext: The expedition wasn't the only group of scientists to wait before publishing a discovery.
activities.instructions: Research a historical scientific discovery that required years of verification before acceptance.
activities.output: None required — this is an open investigation.

prompts: Why do you think the expedition chose to preserve their evidence rather than risk being wrong?

discussionPoints: Why do you think the expedition waited to publish their discoveries?
What was the most surprising thing you learned from the final report?
parentGuide.assessment: Look for a summary that captures the key findings and a completed archive that reflects the learner's own discoveries.

completionCriteria: Final report read, evidence compared, missing archive sections completed, and findings summarised.
